rules.BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S066-R001:
# BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S066-R001 — Licence for taking ship to sea
rule_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S066-R001
rule_version: 1
domain: LICENCE
obligation_dimension: licence_to_sail

legal_source:
  provision_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S066
  legal_version_id: lv-BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-v2
  instrument_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983
  locator: Section 66

applicability:
  all:
    - flag: [BD]
    - operation: [SEA_VOYAGE]

condition:
  type: MANDATORY
  expression: |
    EXISTS e IN evidence :
      e.evidence_type = "LICENSE_TO_SAIL"
      AND NOT expired(e, at: eval_date)

outcome:
  compliant_if: valid licence for taking ship to sea on file
  non_compliant_if: licence absent or expired
  contract_requirement: "Ship must hold a valid licence for taking the ship to sea (Section 66)."

evidence_required:
  - LICENSE_TO_SAIL

status_ladder:
  BLACK: 'NOT (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "LICENSE_TO_SAIL")'
  RED: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "LICENSE_TO_SAIL" AND expired(e, at: eval_date)'
  YELLOW: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "LICENSE_TO_SAIL" AND expires_within(e, 60)'

consequence_of_non_correction: "Taking a ship to sea without the licence is an offence; detention and penalty exposure."
rules.BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S082-R001:
# BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S082-R001 — Manning of ships
# Blueprint v2.0 Part 9.2 canonical example, executable against ILRMF-DSL.
#
# Verification gate: the provision backing this rule must reach
# VERIFIED_AGAINST_GAZETTE before the rule may go ACTIVE (Principle 12).
rule_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S082-R001
rule_version: 1
domain: MANNING
obligation_dimension: manning_level

legal_source:
  provision_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S082
  legal_version_id: lv-BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-v2
  instrument_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983
  locator: Section 82

applicability:
  all:
    - flag: [BD]
    - operation: [SEA_VOYAGE]
    - ship_type: [CARGO, TANKER, PASSENGER]

condition:
  type: MANDATORY
  expression: |
    (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "SAFE_MANNING_DOCUMENT")
    AND (FORALL crew_member IN current_crew :
           crew_member.coc_valid(at: eval_date)
           AND crew_member.rank IN required_ranks)

outcome:
  compliant_if: condition true
  non_compliant_if: any part false
  contract_requirement: "Ship must carry the safe manning document and every crew member must hold a valid Certificate of Competency for their rank."

evidence_required:
  - SAFE_MANNING_DOCUMENT
  - CREW_LIST
  - COC_PER_CREW_MEMBER

status_ladder:
  BLACK: 'NOT (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "SAFE_MANNING_DOCUMENT")'
  RED: 'EXISTS c IN current_crew : NOT c.coc_valid(at: eval_date)'
  YELLOW: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : expires_within(e, 60)'

consequence_of_non_correction: "Detention risk under port-State control; licence-to-sail exposure (S66)."
rules.BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S335-R001:
# BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S335-R001 — Load line certificate
rule_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S335-R001
rule_version: 1
domain: LOADLINE
obligation_dimension: load_line_certification

legal_source:
  provision_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S335
  legal_version_id: lv-BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-v2
  instrument_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983
  locator: Section 335

applicability:
  all:
    - flag: [BD]
    - operation: [SEA_VOYAGE, PORT_CALL]

condition:
  type: MANDATORY
  expression: |
    EXISTS e IN evidence :
      e.evidence_type = "LOAD_LINE_CERTIFICATE"
      AND NOT expired(e, at: eval_date)

outcome:
  compliant_if: valid load line certificate on file
  non_compliant_if: certificate absent or expired
  contract_requirement: "Ship must hold a valid Load Line Certificate on board at all times while at sea or in port."

evidence_required:
  - LOAD_LINE_CERTIFICATE

status_ladder:
  BLACK: 'NOT (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "LOAD_LINE_CERTIFICATE")'
  RED: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "LOAD_LINE_CERTIFICATE" AND expired(e, at: eval_date)'
  YELLOW: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "LOAD_LINE_CERTIFICATE" AND expires_within(e, 60)'

consequence_of_non_correction: "Vessel may be detained; load-line offences carry penalty exposure."
rules.BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S350-R001:
# BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S350-R001 — Unseaworthy ships
rule_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S350-R001
rule_version: 1
domain: UNSEAWORTHY
obligation_dimension: seaworthiness

legal_source:
  provision_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-S350
  legal_version_id: lv-BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983-v2
  instrument_id: BD-ORD-MERCHANT-SHIPPING-1983
  locator: Section 350

applicability:
  all:
    - flag: [BD]
    - operation: [SEA_VOYAGE, PORT_CALL]

condition:
  type: MANDATORY
  expression: |
    (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "CLASS_CERTIFICATE" AND verified(e))
    AND (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "SAFETY_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE" AND NOT expired(e, at: eval_date))

outcome:
  compliant_if: valid class + safety equipment certificates verified on file
  non_compliant_if: any missing/expired/unverified
  contract_requirement: "Ship must be seaworthy: valid class certificate and safety equipment certificate must be on board and not expired."

evidence_required:
  - CLASS_CERTIFICATE
  - SAFETY_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE

status_ladder:
  BLACK: 'NOT (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "CLASS_CERTIFICATE")'
  RED: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "SAFETY_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE" AND expired(e, at: eval_date)'
  YELLOW: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "CLASS_CERTIFICATE" AND NOT verified(e)'

consequence_of_non_correction: "Detention and liability exposure; sending an unseaworthy ship to sea is an offence (S351)."
rules.IMO-CONV-MARPOL-73-78-ANI-REG36-R001:
# IMO-CONV-MARPOL-73-78-ANI-REG36-R001 — Oil Record Book (Annex I)
rule_id: IMO-CONV-MARPOL-73-78-ANI-REG36-R001
rule_version: 1
domain: MARPOL
obligation_dimension: marpol_annex_i_records

legal_source:
  provision_id: IMO-CONV-MARPOL-73-78-ANI-REG36
  legal_version_id: lv-MARPOL-73-78-ANI-current
  instrument_id: IMO-CONV-MARPOL-73-78
  locator: Annex I Regulation 36

applicability:
  all:
    - annex_ratified_for_flag: [I]
    - operation: [SEA_VOYAGE, PORT_CALL]
    - gt_min: 400

condition:
  type: MANDATORY
  expression: |
    EXISTS e IN evidence :
      e.evidence_type = "OIL_RECORD_BOOK"
      AND verified(e)
      AND NOT expired(e, at: eval_date)

outcome:
  compliant_if: valid Oil Record Book on board (MARPOL Annex I Reg 36)
  non_compliant_if: record book missing, unverified or expired
  contract_requirement: "Ships of 400 GT and above must carry a valid Oil Record Book (MARPOL Annex I)."

evidence_required:
  - OIL_RECORD_BOOK

status_ladder:
  BLACK: 'NOT (EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "OIL_RECORD_BOOK")'
  RED: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "OIL_RECORD_BOOK" AND expired(e, at: eval_date)'
  YELLOW: 'EXISTS e IN evidence : e.evidence_type = "OIL_RECORD_BOOK" AND NOT verified(e)'

consequence_of_non_correction: "PSC detention risk; MARPOL offences carry penalty exposure for the company and the master."

condition:
